items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: I know on several occasions I was notified by one person or another that a particular group... Billy and Dee Dee Pierce and their group... And we were talking about the Billy and Dee Dee Pierce audition.

ctx.x: Well, they certainly didn't mind doing it. I think at times they didn't have many jobs, even people like Joyce Lewis. Yeah. There was a chance for them to get together and play. That's true. It certainly wasn't a rehearsal. No, it wasn't. Did you go to rehearsals ever?

I don't, I probably have gone to a rehearsal. I've gone more to auditions than I have to a rehearsal. Yeah. I know on several occasions I was notified by one person or another that a particular group, well, it seems to me that you had one for Billy. Billy and Dee Dee Pierce and their group in the back of the New Orleans record shop. I'll pass the leader.
I'll pass the leader. We got the tape on there.
